scope: Implicit source functions, intrinsics, constants and declaration types. No std modules are imported. Contexts are separate contracts; ordinary functions are shared by interpreter and AOT. Parameters are required unless defaults explicitly say otherwise.

entries.name: agent
entries.purpose: 声明专用agent构造计划，显式模型别名及可选默认二参learner，不训练。

entries.name: environment
entries.signature: environment NAME { observation: f32[N]; action: f32[A]; feedback: f32[F]; reset: FUNCTION; step: FUNCTION; }
entries.purpose: 声明同步WGT环境状态与reset/step schema；实例构造reset一次。

entries.name: learn
entries.purpose: 整批collect成功后释放目标policy保护并调用一次具名同步二参learner。

entries.name: __agent
entries.purpose: Compiler-only agent constructor; source __ names rejected.

entries.name: __environment
entries.purpose: Compiler-only environment constructor; source __ names rejected.

entries.name: __record
entries.purpose: Compiler-only bounded finite record literal; source __ names rejected.

entries.name: async
entries.purpose: 创建冷用户future；显式纯数据参数与返回值；第一阶段拒绝资源/模型异步执行。

entries.name: tasks
entries.purpose: 同步函数内有界任务作用域，正常join、失败取消并等待在途IO；首期不支持嵌套。

entries.name: await
entries.purpose: 驱动冷future或等待作用域task，拒绝任意同步值。

entries.name: spawn
entries.purpose: 在tasks内启动作用域子任务，禁止默认脱离。

entries.name: sleep
entries.purpose: 仅async fn：固定阻塞池等待0..30000整数毫秒，返回null；不是定时器reactor。

entries.name: save
entries.purpose: 显式原子保存 model/checkpoint/json/text；默认拒绝覆盖，父目录必须存在，路径按脚本根目录解析。

entries.name: load
entries.purpose: 读取 model/checkpoint/json/text；model必填using新优化器，checkpoint恢复已记录优化器，不执行训练或main。

entries.name: reload
entries.signature: reload model TARGET from PATH using OPTIMIZER; | reload checkpoint TARGET from PATH;
entries.purpose: 同句柄同结构原子重载，model新优化器，checkpoint恢复状态；revision单调递增，旧梯度失效。

entries.name: __record_field
entries.purpose: Compiler-only record field projection; source __ calls rejected. RecordBatch columns retain row order and charge traversal; plain indexed lists are rejected.

entries.name: assert
entries.purpose: 条件必须bool且仅求值一次；仅失败时求消息。兼容两实参assert(condition,message)保持急求值。

entries.name: differentiate_at
entries.purpose: 在临时参数上用首次梯度句柄保存的同批数据重新求一阶梯度，不写真实模型；返回新句柄，parameters/state/steps仍为原始提交基准，loss/gradients为临时点结果。共享句柄及内存预算，拒绝过期版本。

entries.name: differentiate
entries.purpose: CPU forward 模型通过 fn loss 求批次平均损失和初始参数梯度，不提交；要求 optimizer none。返回梯度句柄，最多16个存活句柄，共享64MiB预算。

entries.name: gradient_snapshot
entries.purpose: 读取梯度快照对象：loss、parameters、gradients、names、shapes、state、steps；参数按稳定顺序列出非冻结参数，数据为行优先扁平列表。

entries.name: commit_gradients
entries.purpose: 原子提交完整候选参数和用户优化器状态，返回更新前loss并释放句柄；拒绝过期快照、非有限f32、布局错误和资源状态。状态深度至多32、计量大小至多1MiB。

entries.name: release_gradient
entries.purpose: 释放未提交梯度快照并返回null；重复释放或提交后的句柄报错。Runtime结束释放所有剩余句柄。

entries.name: __graph
entries.purpose: Compiler-only sequential model construction.

entries.name: __adaptive
entries.purpose: Compiler-only forward model construction.

entries.name: dependency
entries.purpose: Resolve an explicitly locked dependency to its local artifact path.

entries.name: len
entries.purpose: 列表长度

entries.name: range
entries.purpose: 非负整数半开区间；end >= start，最多 1000000 项

entries.name: append
entries.purpose: 返回追加后的新列表，不原地改动；最多 1000000 项

entries.name: column
entries.purpose: 从对象列表逐行提取字段，缺失即报错

entries.name: sum
entries.purpose: 等长分布，标量 `sum(p*(log(p)-log(q)))`；方向是目标 p 相对参考 q，不对称

entries.name: sqrt
entries.purpose: Scalar square root; reject nonfinite results.

entries.name: rsqrt
entries.purpose: `1/sqrt(x)`，x > 0；精确平方根再取倒数，未使用低精度快速近似

entries.name: fma
entries.purpose: 融合乘加 x*y+z，只舍入一次

entries.name: hypot
entries.purpose: 欧氏长度，避免直接平方造成中间溢出/下溢

entries.name: expm1
entries.purpose: exp(x)-1，保留接近零的小量精度

entries.name: log1p
entries.purpose: log(1+x)，x > -1，保留接近零的小量精度

entries.name: sigmoid
entries.purpose: logistic，按正负分支避免指数溢出

entries.name: softplus
entries.purpose: max(x,0)+log1p(exp(-abs(x)))，避免大正数指数溢出

entries.name: silu
entries.purpose: x*sigmoid(x)，使用稳定 sigmoid

entries.name: dot
entries.purpose: 标量内积；长度相同，顺序 FMA 累加

entries.name: norm
entries.purpose: 标量 L2 长度；逐步 hypot 避免直接平方溢出

entries.name: mean
entries.purpose: 标量均值；先除 N 再求和以减少求和溢出；后缀无参数，语义及预算相同

entries.name: softmax
entries.purpose: `[N]` 概率；减最大值后指数归一化

entries.name: log_softmax
entries.purpose: `[N]` 对数概率；直接在对数域计算，避免概率下溢后取 log

entries.name: logsumexp
entries.purpose: 标量 log(sum(exp(x)))；减最大值稳定计算

entries.name: l2_normalize
entries.purpose: `[N]`，x/max(norm(x),eps)；eps 有限且 >0；缩放后求范数，零向量返回零

entries.name: mse
entries.purpose: 标量均方误差；等长，均值取全部 N 个元素

entries.name: mae
entries.purpose: 标量平均绝对误差；等长

entries.name: cross_entropy
entries.purpose: 单样本标量负对数似然；target 为 0..N-1 的整数，不接受概率标签

entries.name: min
entries.purpose: 标量最小/最大值

entries.name: max
entries.purpose: 标量最小/最大值

entries.name: argmin
entries.purpose: 极值首次出现的索引，数值相等的正负零也按首次处理

entries.name: argmax
entries.purpose: 极值首次出现的索引，数值相等的正负零也按首次处理

entries.name: variance
entries.purpose: 标量方差，分母 N-ddof；ddof 为整数且 0<=ddof<N；0 是总体方差、1 是样本方差

entries.name: stddev
entries.purpose: 同一方差定义的标准差；先缩放和中心化，避免直接平方溢出

entries.name: median
entries.purpose: 排序后中位数；偶数长度取中间两数平均

entries.name: quantile
entries.purpose: q 为 [0,1] 数值；对升序序列位置 q*(N-1) 做线性插值，单元素返回该元素

entries.name: sort
entries.purpose: 升序 `[N]`，稳定排序；不修改原列表

entries.name: argsort
entries.purpose: 升序对应的原始索引 `[N]`，相等元素保持原顺序

entries.name: cumsum
entries.purpose: 包含当前元素的顺序前缀和 `[N]`；任何中间和溢出均报错

entries.name: cosine_similarity
entries.purpose: 标量余弦相似度，等长且两个向量均非零；分别缩放后求内积与范数，最终裁剪到 [-1,1]

entries.name: clip
entries.purpose: 逐元素裁剪到闭区间，同形返回；两边界有限且 lower<=upper

entries.name: relu
entries.purpose: 标量 max(x,0)

entries.name: leaky_relu
entries.purpose: x>=0 时 x，否则 alpha*x；alpha 有限且 >=0

entries.name: elu
entries.purpose: x>=0 时 x，否则 alpha*expm1(x)；alpha 有限且 >=0

entries.name: hard_sigmoid
entries.purpose: 标量 clamp(x/6+0.5,0,1)，端点 -3 与 3

entries.name: hard_swish
entries.purpose: 标量 x*hard_sigmoid(x)，分段计算避免中间溢出

entries.name: bce_logits
entries.purpose: 等长 `[N]` → 标量均值二元交叉熵；targets 每项在 [0,1]，支持软标签；输入为 logits 而非概率

entries.name: huber
entries.purpose: 等长 `[N]` → 标量均值；delta 有限且 >0；绝对残差 d<=delta 时 0.5*d²，否则 delta*(d-0.5*delta)

entries.name: log_cosh
entries.purpose: 等长 `[N]` → 标量均值 log(cosh(x-y))，小残差用 log1p，大残差在对数域计算

entries.name: moving_mean
entries.purpose: `[N]` → `[N-window+1]`，仅有效窗口、不填充；window 是 1..N 的整数

entries.name: zeros
entries.purpose: 长度 count 的全零列表，count 为 0..1,000,000 的整数

entries.name: ones
entries.purpose: 同上，填充 1

entries.name: full
entries.purpose: 同上，填充有限 f64 value；即使 count=0 也验证 value

entries.name: linspace
entries.purpose: 等间距列表，含两端点；start/end 有限，count 为 1..1,000,000 整数；count=1 仅返回 start，支持降序

entries.name: concat
entries.purpose: 拼接 `[N]` 与 `[M]` 为 `[N+M]`，总长度不超过上限

entries.name: vector_slice
entries.purpose: 左闭右开 `[start,end)`，要求整数 0<=start<=end<=N；输出 `[end-start]`，不支持步长或负索引

entries.name: gather
entries.purpose: 按整数索引列表顺序取值，输出长度等于索引数；允许重复，全部索引须在 0..N-1，空 indices 合法

entries.name: compress
entries.purpose: mask 是等长 bool 列表，仅保留 true 位置且保持顺序；不将 0/1 隐式转为 bool；全 false 返回空列表

entries.name: one_hot
entries.purpose: `[classes]`，index 位置为 1，其余为 0；classes 是 1..1,000,000 整数，index 是 0..classes-1 整数

entries.name: reverse
entries.purpose: 返回倒序的新 `[N]` 列表

entries.name: entropy
entries.purpose: 标量 Shannon 熵 `-sum(p*log(p))`，零概率项贡献为 0

entries.name: normalize_probabilities
entries.purpose: 非负权重、至少一项>0；先除最大值再归一化，返回同形概率列表，避免直接求和溢出

entries.name: kl_divergence
entries.purpose: 等长分布，标量 `sum(p*(log(p)-log(q)))`；方向是目标 p 相对参考 q，不对称

entries.name: js_divergence
entries.purpose: 等长分布，标量 `(KL(p,m)+KL(q,m))/2`，m=(p+q)/2；对称，精确值在 [0,log(2)]

entries.name: cross_entropy_probs
entries.purpose: 等长分布，标量 `-sum(p*log(q))`；p 是目标分布，q 是预测概率；不同于接受 logits 和类别编号的 `cross_entropy`

entries.name: temperature_softmax
entries.purpose: 正且有限的温度；同形输出 softmax(logits/temperature)，温度 1 对应普通 softmax

entries.name: log
entries.purpose: Scalar natural logarithm; reject nonfinite results.

entries.name: exp
entries.purpose: Scalar exponential; reject nonfinite results.

entries.name: assert
entries.purpose: bool 为 false 时终止脚本

entries.name: metric
entries.purpose: 按名称保存 JSON 指标；同名覆盖，只保留最后值，不自动平均或 detach

entries.name: seed
entries.purpose: 设置脚本局部采样 RNG；整数范围 [0,1000000000]

entries.name: random
entries.purpose: 确定性 SplitMix64 流，返回 [0,1)；不影响模型初始化 RNG

entries.name: mlp
entries.purpose: 新建 CPU f32 顺序网络；widths 是包括输入输出的 2..64 个整数，每个 1..16384，最多 4000000 参数；隐藏层 activation 为 relu/tanh/sigmoid/identity，输出层始终 linear；optimizer 为 sgd/adam

entries.name: model
entries.purpose: Legacy alias of load_model; 加载原生顺序 IR 或 forward Program IR v1 JSON，使用新优化器；forward 另可选 none；不是普通 .wgt 模型解析器，也不接受传统 manifest 制品

entries.name: save_model
entries.purpose: 导出原生推理 IR v1 JSON；不包含优化器；forward 使用 Program 格式，供 model() 或 wgt-native adaptive 加载

entries.name: predict
entries.purpose: 输入单个 f32 向量，返回输出列表；普通模型不训练，`forward` 模型可通过显式 `write` 提交参数更新

entries.name: fit
entries.purpose: 一个批次一次更新，返回更新前损失；lr 正有限；loss 为 mse/cross_entropy，forward 模型还可用 `loss` 调用同文件 `fn loss`

entries.name: reinforce
entries.purpose: 一批观测的策略梯度更新，返回更新前的 mean(-advantage*log pi(action))

entries.name: train
entries.purpose: forward 自定义损失的批次平均梯度、全局 L2 裁剪及原子更新；等价 train 语句，见[原生 RL](reinforcement-learning.md)

entries.name: gae
entries.purpose: 同长度一维列表；后两种标记是 bool，gamma/lambda 在 [0,1]；返回优势列表

entries.name: jsonl
entries.purpose: 打开 UTF-8 JSON Lines 数据流；每行一个 JSON 值，不允许空行

entries.name: hf_dataset
entries.purpose: Rust 原生 Hugging Face 分页数据流；全部参数必填，首次 batch 联网；HF_TOKEN 可选，详见 [数据集契约](datasets.md#原生数据集加载器wgt-05当前源码)

entries.name: batch
entries.purpose: count 在 1..65536；返回最多 count 行；尾批保留，到 EOF 返回 []；单行 <=1MiB、单批 <=16MiB

entries.name: close
entries.purpose: 关闭流，重复关闭无操作；关闭后 batch 报错

entries.name: save
entries.purpose: Legacy alias of save_checkpoint; 保存顺序或 forward 训练断点：结构、权重、冻结关系、优化器类别、步数和矩状态；顺序模型另保留共享关系

entries.name: restore
entries.purpose: Legacy alias of load_checkpoint; 读取断点，返回模型及恢复后的优化器

entries.name: benchmark
entries.purpose: mode 默认 cpu；支持同步 GPU 前向和 train:cpu MSE 训练步；warmup 0..10000，repeats 1..100000；完整契约见[原生测试](native-testing.md#benchmark)

entries.name: load_model
entries.purpose: 加载原生顺序 IR 或 forward Program IR v1 JSON，使用新优化器；forward 另可选 none；不是普通 .wgt 模型解析器，也不接受传统 manifest 制品

entries.name: save_checkpoint
entries.purpose: 保存顺序或 forward 训练断点：结构、权重、冻结关系、优化器类别、步数和矩状态；顺序模型另保留共享关系

entries.name: load_checkpoint
entries.purpose: 读取断点，返回模型及恢复后的优化器

entries.name: detach
entries.purpose: Stop the input gradient.

entries.name: exp
entries.purpose: Elementwise exponential.

entries.name: log
entries.purpose: Elementwise natural logarithm.

entries.name: log_softmax
entries.purpose: Stable vector log probabilities.

entries.name: minimum
entries.purpose: Elementwise minimum; ties split gradients equally.

entries.name: clip
entries.purpose: Elementwise clamp using signed literal bounds; zero gradient at endpoints.

entries.name: sum
entries.purpose: Reduce f32[N] to f32[1].

entries.name: read
entries.purpose: 读取参数当前值，结果为扁平向量；直接引用参数也会读取

entries.name: linear
entries.purpose: out 必填；in 默认前层宽度；bias 仅 0/1，默认 1；可用 `linear(M)`

entries.name: add
entries.purpose: 等长逐元素运算，无广播

entries.name: mul
entries.purpose: 等长逐元素运算，无广播

entries.name: mean
entries.purpose: Reduce f32[N] to f32[1]; also x.mean.

entries.name: square
entries.purpose: Elementwise square.

entries.name: gate
entries.purpose: 返回 p*x；x 为 f32[N]，p 为 f32[1] 或 f32[N]，每项须在 [0,1]；标量门广播；推理时 p 全为 0 跳过 x 表达式

entries.name: route
entries.purpose: 返回 p*a+(1-p)*b；a/b 同为 f32[N]，p 为 f32[1] 或 f32[N] 且在 [0,1]；推理时 p 全为 1 只求值 a，全为 0 只求值 b，否则计算两边

entries.name: relu
entries.purpose: 等长逐元素运算

entries.name: tanh
entries.purpose: 等长逐元素运算

entries.name: sigmoid
entries.purpose: 等长逐元素运算

entries.name: softmax
entries.purpose: f32[N] 沿唯一向量轴归一化，返回 f32[N]；稳定指数实现，支持一阶梯度

entries.name: slice
entries.purpose: Slice fixed tensor using literal zero-based start and positive length; no default arguments.

entries.name: positive
entries.purpose: Condition only: f32[1] strictly greater than zero.

entries.name: write
entries.purpose: 全量替换非冻结参数，元素数须相同

entries.name: true
entries.purpose: Boolean literal.

entries.name: false
entries.purpose: Boolean literal.

entries.name: null
entries.purpose: Null value; also the implicit function return.

entries.name: f32
entries.purpose: Fixed-shape 32-bit floating-point tensor; supported ranks depend on declaration.

entries.name: prob
entries.purpose: Probability parameter represented by a logit; trainable initial value strictly in (0,1), frozen permits endpoints; reads f32[1]. Initializer required.

entries.name: linear
entries.purpose: Sequential affine layer; out required, in defaults to preceding width, bias defaults to 1.

entries.name: relu
entries.purpose: Sequential activation preserving vector width.

entries.name: tanh
entries.purpose: Sequential activation preserving vector width.

entries.name: sigmoid
entries.purpose: Sequential activation preserving vector width.

entries.name: identity
entries.purpose: Sequential activation preserving vector width.

entries.name: __probabilities
entries.purpose: Compiler-only target for typed value.probabilities; source calls with __ prefix are rejected. Stable softmax for logits, strict validation and identity for probabilities, ordinary f32 rejected.

entries.name: logits
entries.purpose: Finite, nonempty mutually exclusive category scores. Explicit output metadata survives model persistence and function values. .probabilities applies stable softmax along the category axis. Output declarations only; no binary logit type.

entries.name: probabilities
entries.purpose: Finite mutually exclusive category vector, each value strictly in [0,1], sum within absolute 1e-5 of 1. Conversion validates and preserves values; no renormalization. Sampling scales by actual total mass and skips zero-mass entries. CPU native implementation; GPU categorical path not verified.
